promo.heading: Not Just a Paper Trail. Farm OS Verified.
promo.lead: Enter a batch ID to see harvest dates, GPS coordinates, quality metrics, certification records, and a tamper-proof digital signature — all pulled directly from our Farm OS. The same data our farm managers use. The same dashboard our investors see. No marketing fluff. No paperwork generated after the fact.

Scan the QR code or enter your batch ID to see the full digital record — from the exact block in Odienné to your container. Most suppliers send paperwork. We send proof. Now with digital signatures for every batch.

privacy.title: Your Batch Is Private
privacy.body: Each batch has a unique tracking code — printed on the QR sticker, Bill of Lading, and Certificate of Origin. Only someone with that code can view the batch record. We never publish customer batches, and we never reveal what shipments exist in our system.

faq.title: Common Questions
faq.q1: How do I find my batch ID?
faq.a1: Your batch ID is printed on the QR code sticker attached to every 50kg bag and on your Bill of Lading and Certificate of Origin.
faq.q2: What if the batch ID doesn't work?
faq.a2: Check for typos — batch IDs are case-sensitive. If it still doesn't work, contact us at info@afrinutsexport.com with your invoice number.
faq.q3: Can I verify the digital signature independently?
faq.a3: Yes — every batch has a tamper-proof verification code you can check without login. The signature proves the data hasn't been altered since signing.
faq.q4: Who can see my batch record?
faq.a4: Anyone with your unique tracking code can view the public traceability summary (origin, quality grade, certifications, and status). However, the full private record — including lab results, farmer details, exact weights, export documents, and pricing — is only available to the verified buyer via the Buyer Portal login. We never allow browsing without a specific code.
faq.q5: How do I access my full buyer record?
faq.a5: Buyers receive a secure magic link by email whenever a batch is assigned to them. Click the link to sign in — no password required. If you're a buyer and haven't received your link, contact us at info@afrinutsexport.com.

trust.title: What Makes Our Traceability Different
trust.farm: Single-origin from our 35-hectare farm in Odienné, Côte d'Ivoire — not mixed lots from unknown sources
trust.batch: Unique batch IDs tracked in Farm OS from harvest to delivery — not a paper ledger
trust.public: Publicly verifiable — anyone with the batch ID can check. No login required.
trust.certs: Certifications verified and displayed per batch — not just claims on a website
trust.ctaBody: Every wholesale order includes Farm OS traceability with digital signatures at no extra cost. Your buyers can verify origin, quality, certifications, and data integrity — just like this page.

verify.title: Record Verification
verify.explanation: This verification code confirms that a Farm OS record was digitally signed and has not been altered. The signature is cryptographically tied to the original batch data.
